me.passkeys.title: My passkeys
me.passkeys.lede: Keep at least two, on different devices.
me.passkeys.addLede: Your device will ask you to confirm with a fingerprint, face or PIN.
me.passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
me.passkeys.lastPasskey: This is your only passkey. Add another one before removing it.
me.passkeys.name: Name
me.passkeys.emptyBody: Add a passkey to sign in on this device.
me.sessions.title: My sessions
me.sessions.lede: Every device you are signed in on. Sign out the ones you do not recognise.
me.sessions.emptyBody: Sign in on a device to see it here.
me.outOfOffice.title: Out of office
me.outOfOffice.lede: Choose who looks after your approvals and reminders while you are away.
me.outOfOffice.untilHint: Your last day away, in your organisation's timezone ({timeZone}). Everything comes back to you the day after.
me.outOfOffice.untilInvalid: Choose today or a later date.
me.outOfOffice.noMatch: No one in your organisation matches "{text}".
me.outOfOffice.delegateCannotApprove: {name} cannot approve, so they cannot stand in for you. Choose someone whose role can approve.
me.outOfOffice.delegateInvalid: Choose another active member of your organisation.
me.outOfOffice.what: While you are away, your approval requests and reminders go to your delegate. They can approve only what their own role allows.
me.outOfOffice.stays: Mentions and your weekly digest still come to you.
me.outOfOffice.alreadyAway: You are already away. End that first to set a new one.
me.outOfOffice.awayBody: Until {date}. {name} receives your approval requests and reminders.
me.outOfOffice.back: You are back. Approval requests and reminders come to you again.
me.outOfOffice.errorTitle: Could not load your out of office
me.tokens.title: My access tokens
me.tokens.lede: A token lets an agent you run read bleqq as you. It reads only, never more than you can, and it cannot sign in or approve anything.
me.tokens.cannotCreate: Creating tokens needs {permission}, which your role does not include. Ask your administrator if you need one.
me.tokens.newBody: It is not shown again. Keep it where your agent keeps its secrets, never in code. It stops working on {date}, or sooner if you revoke it.
me.tokens.name: Name
me.tokens.nameHint: Where the token will live, so you know which to revoke.
me.tokens.scopesHint: Only what you can read yourself.
me.tokens.scopesRequired: Pick at least one thing it may read.
me.tokens.scope.tenant:read: Our register decisions, through a named agent
me.tokens.scopeNotHeld: Needs {permission}, which your role does not include.
me.tokens.entryHint: Optional. Naming one narrows the token to that agent's scope as well as yours.
me.tokens.entryNone: None: it reads what I can read
me.tokens.entryRequired: Reading our register decisions needs a named agent.
me.tokens.expiresHint: Required. A token lives a limited time; pick the last day it should work.
me.tokens.stepUpHint: Creating a token asks for your passkey.
me.tokens.revokeBody: Its next call is refused. It stays on the list as revoked.
me.tokens.revokedDone: Revoked. The token no longer works.
me.tokens.emptyBody: Create one when an agent you run needs to read bleqq as you.
me.tokens.refusal.scopeNotHeld: Your role no longer covers something you picked. Reload and choose again.
me.tokens.refusal.unknownKey: Something you chose is no longer ours to choose. Reload and try again.
me.tokens.refusal.expiryTooLate: That is further ahead than a token may live. Choose an earlier date.
admin.credentials.lede: Every key and token of the organisation: our integrations, the agents we register, and our members' own tokens. No key can change the library.
admin.credentials.emptyBody: Create a key when an integration needs one. Our agents' keys and our members' tokens show here too.
admin.credentials.revokeKeyBody: Anything using it stops working now.
admin.credentials.revokeTokenBody: Its next call is refused. It stays on {person}'s list and this one as revoked.
